power_diagnostic.label: conservative_diagnostic_only

assumptions.independence: independent cases per arm (nested trials are NOT independent; this approximation ignores clustering and trial nesting)

power_diagnostic.full_replication_call_count_formula: 28 skills × 3 deployment models × 3 primary arms × 5 nested trials × 4078 cases = 5,138,280
power_diagnostic.conclusion: Plainly beyond USD 2,000 portfolio ceiling even before diagnostic arms, judge calls, cluster inflation, or screening. Do not claim 90% power under the frozen design.
notes: Nested trials are repeated measures on the same case, not independent samples; treating them as independent would understate required N further once clustering is modeled.
Cluster-bootstrap / hierarchical design typically requires still larger N than this independent-proportion lower bound.
This freeze records the calculation as a hard feasibility bound, not an operable powered study plan.
